admin_desc_users: User account: identity, language, preferences, photo, first-login flag.
admin_desc_langues: Reference list of available languages (Used = enabled in the app — currently en/fr).
admin_desc_agerange: Reference list of age ranges (selectable if Used), manageable from the Admin area.
admin_desc_hobby: Reference list of hobbies (multi-select, translatable), manageable from the Admin area.
admin_desc_musicgenre: Reference list of music genres (multi-select, translatable), manageable from the Admin area.
admin_desc_country: Reference list of countries (Europe scope): used by Users.Country and to prioritize radio search.
admin_desc_podcastusers: A user's podcast subscription + their own stats.
admin_desc_episodesusers: Episodes tracked by a user: status (New/Unread/Read), like.
admin_desc_podcastcomment: Comment thread of a podcast: one row per comment (user, text, date).
admin_desc_radiousers: A user's favorite radios + their own stats (listens, like).
admin_desc_radiocomment: Comment thread of a radio: one row per comment (user, text, date).
admin_desc_musicalbum: Shared album catalog (album artist, compilation flag, Deezer/iTunes cover).
admin_desc_musictrack: Shared track catalog, local MP3 or YouTube Music (global like/dislike/comment counters, genre, age range).
admin_desc_musicusers: Link between a user and a track: listens, like, comment, 'New' status.
admin_desc_musictrackcomment: Comment thread of a track: one row per comment (user, text, date).
admin_desc_play: Current playback state per user (type, URL, Play/Pause/Stop).
admin_desc_log: Activity log: screen visited (Frame), date/time, device, IP, OS.
admin_desc_castdevice: Cast devices discovered on the local network (SoundTouch, DLNA), refreshed by the scheduled scan job.
admin_desc_loginhistory: Login attempts (success, invalid, locked) and remember-me cookie resumes: date/time, device, IP, OS.
admin_job_music_purge: Purge deleted MP3s (hidden for more than 30 days)
admin_job_mp3_result: {added} new, {updated} updated (tags changed), {hidden} hidden (file deleted), {restored} restored
admin_desc_radioplugin: Radio "now playing" plug-ins: script, API key, version and last test status.
admin_plugins_intro: Each radio is linked to a plug-in that fetches the current show or song; without one, the title sent by the stream (ICY) is shown if any. Scripts live in the radio_plugins/ folder. An uploaded script runs on the server: only install trusted code.
admin_plugin_upload_hint: Python script exposing detect(stream_url, name) and fetch(ref, stream_url, api_key) (see app/now_playing.py). A script with the same name replaces the installed version, which is kept for rollback.
admin_plugin_bad_name: Invalid script name: lowercase letters, digits and _ only, .py extension.
admin_plugin_test_no_radio: No radio is linked to "{name}": nothing to test.
admin_plugin_delete_confirm: Delete the "{name}" plug-in? Its script and previous versions will be erased. Linked radios: {count} (they will switch to another plug-in if one recognizes them, otherwise to the stream metadata).

admin_mp3_folder_tags_hint: Only the filled-in fields are applied to every MP3 in this folder (subfolders excluded).
admin_mp3_drop_hint: Drag a file or folder onto a folder (or onto the path above) to move it. Drop MP3s or folders from your computer to upload them.

admin_mp3_err_tags: Unable to read or write this file's tags.

admin_update_up_to_date: Tunoova {local_version} is up to date (checked on {checked_at}).
admin_update_confirm: The app will be stopped during the update (a few minutes): playback will stop for all users. The database is backed up first. Continue?
admin_update_state_failed: The update failed. See the log below (full log in /var/log/tunoova-update.log).
admin_update_refused: Update not possible: an update is already running or the update service is not installed.
admin_backups_intro: Folder: {path}. Backups older than {days} day(s) are deleted automatically (including those made before an update or a restore).
admin_backup_restored: Restore complete from {name} ({photos} photo(s)). The previous state was saved to {safety}.
admin_backup_no_photos: The archive must contain the profile_photos/ folder with the profile photos.
admin_backup_invalid: The database in the archive is not a valid Tunoova database: restore cancelled, nothing was changed.
admin_backups_download_hint: Database and profile photos in a single zip
admin_backups_restore_intro: Select an archive downloaded from this tab (Download button): tunoova_backup_….zip, which contains the database and the profile photos.
admin_backups_restore_warning: The current database and photos will be replaced, then the app will restart. A backup of the current state is made first.
admin_backups_restarting: Restarting the app… the page will reload automatically.
admin_backup_not_zip: This file is not a zip archive.
admin_backup_no_db: The archive must contain exactly one database (.db) at its root.
admin_backup_upload_too_big: File too large to upload (limit: MP3_UPLOAD_MAX_MB).
admin_backup_restart_manual: Restart the app to finish (systemd service not detected).
admin_remote_intro: Choose how the app can be reached: on the local network only, from outside through a private VPN, or publicly behind a reverse proxy.
admin_remote_ts_no_daemon: The Tailscale service is not responding. To start it, run on the server:
admin_remote_ts_daemon_failed: The Tailscale service fails to start on this server. The update fixes the most common case (machine without /dev/net/tun, e.g. an LXC container); run on the server:
admin_remote_ts_daemon_failed_log: If it still fails, the service log gives the cause:
admin_remote_ts_needs_login: The server is not connected to a Tailscale account yet.
admin_remote_ts_login_hint: Open this link (or scan the QR code) and sign in with your Google, Microsoft or GitHub account. The free Tailscale account is created automatically.
admin_remote_ts_stopped: The server is disconnected from Tailscale.
admin_remote_ts_choose_mode: Choose "Private VPN" or "Public Tailscale Funnel" in the access mode above, then click Apply to connect the server to Tailscale.
admin_remote_ts_connecting: Connecting to Tailscale: checking that this server is still registered in your Tailscale account…
admin_remote_ts_authorize: First activation of the "{label}" mode: allow it for this server on the Tailscale website ("Enable" button).
admin_remote_ts_authorize_nolink: Enable Funnel in the Tailscale console.
admin_remote_ts_operator: The {user} account is not allowed to control Tailscale. Run on the server:
admin_remote_ts_mismatch: Tailscale does not expose the app in this mode. Click Apply to enable it again.
admin_remote_mode_off_hint: The app is reachable on the local network only.
admin_remote_mode_external_hint: The app is reachable publicly, from any browser. You use your own reverse proxy service (Caddy, nginx, Cloudflare Tunnel…), and you configure it yourself.
admin_remote_mode_private_hint: The app is reachable from outside, but only through a VPN (Tailscale). The Tailscale VPN client must be installed on every device that needs to reach it from outside.
admin_remote_mode_public_hint: The app is reachable publicly, from any browser. Tailscale publishes it over HTTPS, with no port forwarding and no domain name (.ts.net address).
admin_remote_public_warning: The app will be visible from the whole Internet. Use strong passwords.
admin_remote_funnel_dns_hint: First activation: the address can take up to 10 minutes to work, while Tailscale publishes it in public DNS. If your browser tried it too early, flush the DNS cache (Windows: ipconfig /flushdns).
admin_remote_msg_pending: "{label}" mode saved: allow it on the Tailscale website.
admin_remote_msg_not_installed: Tailscale is not installed on this server.
admin_remote_msg_login_first: Connect the server to Tailscale (link below): the "{label}" mode will be enabled next.
admin_remote_ts_pending_mode: The "{label}" mode will be enabled as soon as the server is connected.
